description: Transcription (single application): the proof applies the causing-necessity-respect premise, whose consequent is the conclusion's, after the other premise supplies its antecedent, so under invariant 16 it does not expand the target. Whatever causes the being of a necessary being causes its necessity, from two OPEN premises: a necessary being's necessity consists in its being (esse), and causing a thing in the respect in which its necessity consists causes its necessity. Analyses the bridge's 'since its necessity is the necessity of its being' through a typed respect relation.
